prior_findings.same_store_recovery: closed only for the single-writer case

findings.summary: Volatile reconciliation compares counters but not the durable base from which it branched, so a stale writer can overwrite a concurrent same-run durable observation.
Malformed status .json run IDs still raise ValueError through append/status instead of becoming an immutable failure snapshot.

acceptance.C-AC-28: not accepted until branch-safe same-run reconciliation and malformed status handling are corrected
